headline: NEW (big-missed, overnight) -- Russian FAB-250 glide-bomb strike on Kramatorsk residential district Oct 23
dek: Oct 23: three FAB-250 aerial bombs with UMPK glide kits struck a Kramatorsk residential neighborhood -- 1 civilian killed, 6 wounded (3 young children), 27 residential buildings damaged. Separate: Ukrainian General Staff says Russia launched 2,597 Shahed/Parodiya/Gerbera UAVs over the past week;…
sources: Donetsk Regional Prosecutor's Office (via Kyiv Post live blog Oct 24); Ukrainian General Staff (via Ukrinform)
fault_line: 87% interception sounds like air defenses are winning -- until one of the 13% lands on an apartment block. Is Ukraine holding the line or bleeding out?

sections.what_happened: Oct 23: three FAB-250 aerial bombs with UMPK glide kits struck a Kramatorsk residential neighborhood -- 1 civilian killed, 6 wounded (3 young children), 27 residential buildings damaged. Separate: Ukrainian General Staff says Russia launched 2,597 Shahed/Parodiya/Gerbera UAVs over the past week; air defenses neutralized 2,282 (87%+).
sections.what_verified: Single publisher family (Kyiv Post) citing Ukrainian officials; drone-tally from General Staff via Ukrinform (same national information ecosystem). No Russian comment; no independent wire confirmation in this window.
sections.what_disputed: Russia denies intentional targeting of civilians (standing position). Kramatorsk is the last Ukrainian-held hub in Donetsk -- military-logistics framing from Moscow's side is standard.
sections.why_matters: 2,597 drones in 7 days. 87% shot down. The other 13% is why Kramatorsk's children are in hospital tonight.
sections.context: Background: NEW (big-missed, overnight) -- Russian FAB-250 glide-bomb strike on Kramatorsk residential district Oct 23: 1 killed, 6 wounded incl. 3 children, 27 residential buildings damaged (Donetsk prosecutor via Kyiv Post); Ukrinform: 2,597 Russian drones launched over the past week, 87% neutralized

totw_analysis: Our read: 2,597 drones in 7 days. 87% shot down. The other 13% is why Kramatorsk's children are in hospital tonight. The fault line our audience is arguing over: 87% interception sounds like air defenses are winning -- until one of the 13% lands on an apartment block. Is Ukraine holding the line or bleeding out?
